# Story Package: Jacob’s Ladder (Genesis 28)

**Story Key**: `jacobLadder`

**Position in 365 Roadmap**: Phase 1, Story #4 — God’s promise and presence even when we feel alone.

---

## Reverent Read-Aloud Retelling (for ages 3–8)

Jacob was traveling far from home. He had made some wrong choices and was afraid. As the sun went down, he stopped to rest. He found a stone for a pillow and fell asleep.

That night Jacob had a wonderful dream. He saw a ladder reaching all the way from earth up to heaven. Angels were going up and down the ladder. At the top of the ladder stood the Lord.

God spoke to Jacob and said, “I am the Lord, the God of your father Abraham and Isaac. I will give this land to you and your children. Your family will become very many, like the dust of the earth. I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised.”

Jacob woke up and said, “Surely the Lord is in this place, and I did not know it.” He was filled with wonder and a little fear. He took the stone he had used as a pillow, poured oil on it, and made it a special place to remember God’s promise.

Jacob learned that even when we are far from home and feel alone, God is still with us.

Color the sleeping Jacob and the ladder → listen to God’s promise of presence → gentle reminder that God is always with us, even on hard journeys.

## Quiz — 4 Questions (with helpful scaffolding)

**1. What did Jacob use for a pillow when he went to sleep?**
- A) A soft blanket
- B) A stone
- C) His bag
- D) Some grass

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “Jacob didn’t have a blanket. He used a stone from the ground as his pillow that night.”
- If C: “It wasn’t his bag. He picked up a stone and rested his head on it.”
- If D: “He used a hard stone. That’s what made the dream even more surprising and special.”

**2. What did Jacob see in his dream?**
- A) A big house
- B) A ladder going up to heaven with angels on it
- C) Many sheep
- D) A river of water

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “It wasn’t a house. Jacob saw a tall ladder reaching from earth all the way to heaven.”
- If C: “There were no sheep in the dream. He saw angels going up and down a ladder.”
- If D: “It was a ladder with angels, not a river. God was showing Jacob something very important.”

**3. What did God promise Jacob in the dream?**
- A) That he would become very rich with gold
- B) That He would be with Jacob, watch over him, and give him the land
- C) That he could go home right away
- D) That he would never be tired again

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “God didn’t talk about gold. He promised to be with Jacob and bless his family with the land.”
- If C: “Jacob still had a long journey ahead. God promised to stay with him the whole way.”
- If D: “God promised His presence and care, not that Jacob would never feel tired.”

**4. What did Jacob do after he woke up from the dream?**
- A) He ran away and never came back
- B) He poured oil on the stone and made it a special place to remember God’s promise
- C) He threw the stone away
- D) He went back to sleep and forgot about it

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “Jacob didn’t run away forever. He marked the place to remember what God had said.”
- If C: “He kept the stone and made it special by pouring oil on it as a reminder.”
- If D: “Jacob knew this was important. He turned the stone into a memorial of God’s promise.”
